name: NWF Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by Davy Airborne through the record's own July cards; Hilton Flames is champion by 18 August, the title change itself not attested.

name: NWF Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Held by Captain America Rick Dorry throughout this record, last defended against the Arabic Animal at Super Challenge 1.

name: NWF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Vacated, then won by the Brotherhood in a five-team elimination match, last defended successfully on 4 August 1995.
